---
applyTo: "frontend/**"
---

Follow root `AGENTS.md` and `frontend/AGENTS.md`.

Keep Vue 3 Options API, existing state/model patterns, and the current `$gettext` path. Use `make fmt-js`, `make lint-js`, focused Vitest tests, and `make build-js`. Do not add TypeScript, a new state manager, duplicate tooling, or commercial overlay behavior.
